jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**


Technomics is a growing employee\-owned, decision analytics company that provides professional services and management solutions to help our clients make ***better decisions faster***. We enable a wide range of clients across the Federal government, from senior level policy makers to program managers, to ***choose smartly, buy effectively and operate efficiently****.* We deliver practical, credible and defensible results offering actionable insights by applying data\-driven and analytics\-based approaches in combination with multidisciplinary talent, subject matter expertise, and tangible and repeatable assets in the form of databases, models, approaches and techniques.  

  

Analysts have the knowledge, skills, abilities and initiative to deliver timely, practical and innovative solutions to our clients as part of high\-performing project teams typically composed of a mix of junior and mid\-level analysts.


Our employee\-owners pride themselves on their ability to apply deep analytical rigor and innovative thought that assist clients in understanding and solving a myriad of challenging resource planning and management problems.


This position may be located in Arlington, VA (Headquarters), Washington D.C., Pentagon, Springfield, VA., Chantilly, VA., Tysons Corner, VA.  

  

**Position\-Specific Overview**  

Data Analysts will support a U.S. Government client in developing data\-driven solutions using Palantir Foundry and related technologies. The role will support data integration, transformation, analytics, and user\-facing applications that improve access to mission and business information.


The individual will work with technical teams and end users to develop data pipelines, analytical workflows, and applications, translate requirements into practical solutions, and support testing and implementation. Relevant experience includes Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, ETL/ELT, low\-code development, cloud technologies, and UX/UI design. Direct Palantir Foundry experience is preferred but not required.


**Responsibilities and Qualifications**


* Develop, maintain, and improve data pipelines, transformations, analytical workflows, and user\-facing data products in Palantir Foundry and related technologies.
* Work with client stakeholders and technical teams to understand requirements, troubleshoot data issues, and translate business needs into practical analytical solutions.
* Analyze, clean, integrate, and validate data from multiple sources to support reporting, analysis, and operational workflows.
* Develop queries, scripts, dashboards, applications, and other analytical products using tools such as Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, and low\-code applications.
* Support data modeling, database design, testing, documentation, and deployment of new capabilities.
* Apply UX/UI and user\-centered design principles to improve the usability of dashboards, workflows, and analytical applications.
* Use modern software development practices including Git, testing, version control, and collaborative development.


**Minimum Qualifications**


* 2\+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, software development, or a related technical field.
* Experience with Python, SQL, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines and working with relational databases and structured data.
* Experience with low\-code application development, cloud technologies, or UX/UI design.
* Ability to work directly with users to understand requirements and develop data\-driven solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

* Experience with Palantir Foundry or comparable data and analytics platforms.
* Experience with PySpark, Spark, or other large\-scale data processing technologies.
* Experience integrating practical AI capabilities, such as LLMs or machine learning models, into user\-facing applications, workflows, or analytical products.
* Prior experience supporting U.S. Government clients or working in regulated environments.


Salary range: $85,000\- 150,000 USD  

  

The salary range listed is one part of our total compensation package, which may also include bonuses, incentives and benefits. Individual compensation is determined based on qualifications such as relevant years of experience, education, certifications and geographic location.


Technomics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected status under applicable law, including disability and protected veteran status.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco has a new Senior Risk Program Manager position available now in Arlington, VA with the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO).


The F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) is a joint, multi\-national program and is the Department of Defense’s (DoD) focal point for defining affordable next generation strike aircraft weapon systems among the United States (U.S.) Air Force (USAF), U.S. Navy (USN), U.S. Marine Corps (USMC), and U.S. allies currently composed of seven (7\) cooperative international partners: the United Kingdom, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Denmark, and Norway; as well as Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The F\-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting\-edge technologies to the battle\-space of the future. The F\-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F\-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product\-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems \& Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.


Our **Senior Risk Program Manager (PM)**, located at Crystal City, VA, supports the F\-35 Air Vehicle (AV) Program Management Office (PMO) providing lifecycle cost, schedule, and performance of aircraft, avionics, sensors, weapons integration, and modifications in the F\-35 Lightning II Enterprise. The PM supports AV PMO in delivering 5th Generation tactical aircraft to U.S. Services, Partners, and FMS customers.


In this role, you will:


* As the Sr Risk PM to support Air Vehicle:
	+ Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the Production Execution Group in all areas of program risk management.
	+ Support Air Vehicle, Vehicle Systems, and Mission Systems PMOs with Program Executive Officer (PEO)\-level risk management activities and boards.
	+ Assist in the development, drafting, and revision of the Joint Program Office (JPO) Risk Management Plan.
	+ Facilitate and implement Risk Management Tool (RMT) training across the F\-35 JPO enterprise.
	+ Support and participate as the Risk Management SME in the JRWG, a monthly joint Government and industry risk forum, and the quarterly Joint Executive Risk and Opportunity Management Board (EROMB), including preparation and delivery of senior leadership briefings.
	+ Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with senior\-level leadership and engage collaboratively with Government, industry, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
	+ Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience briefing complex risk issues, mitigation strategies, and program impacts to executive\-level audiences.
	+ Review and assess program documentation, including Systems Engineering Plans and related acquisition/program management artifacts, to support risk identification, analysis, and mitigation efforts.
	+ Experience coordinating across multiple stakeholders to facilitate risk\-informed decision\-making within a complex acquisition environment.
* As a SR Risk PM to support Air Vehicle (AV) Mission Systems (MS) in these areas:
	+ F\-35 Block 4 Modernization – assist AV PMO in providing airborne systems capable of operating effectively in highly contested battle spaces now and in the foreseeable future.
	+ Specialized Engineering – assist AV PMO in ensuring that the AV meets the approved design requirements.
	+ Weapons – assist AV PMO in providing lifecycle management of unique aircraft hardware that allow for carriage and employment of weapons; assist in coordinating across the F\-35 enterprise and external weapons programs to ensure necessary designs are implemented across the Air System to permit the effective employment of weapons.
	+ Digital Systems \- assist AV PMO in providing program management and life cycle support in the development and fielding of Digital Core, Digital Infrastructure, Software Development, Digital Engineering, and Cybersecurity initiatives.
	+ Air System Integration \- assist the AV PMO in life cycle management and support for the development, integration, and test of capabilities contained and fielded as an Air System Configuration.
* As a Risk PM to support AV Vehicle Systems (VS) in these areas:
	+ Air Vehicle, Air Vehicle Support Equipment, Pilot Flight Equipment, Ancillary Mission Equipment, Tooling and Test Equipment, Diminishing Manufacturing Sources, Initial Spares, Helmet Mounted Display System, and and Lightning Support Team.

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to provide onsite support at the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) located in Crystal City, VA a minimum of 3 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F\-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.
* An active DoD Secret security clearance.

The Analyst is responsible for conducting research and analysis on relevant industry trends, emerging regulations, and strategic opportunities to fulfill the company’s sustainability objectives, reporting requirements, and program commitments.


The Analyst will play an important role in advancing the company's sustainability agenda, working closely with the team to develop, implement and enhance sustainability initiatives that align with corporate objectives. This position requires a strategic analyst with knowledge of environmental stewardship, social responsibility, and corporate governance practices. The Analyst will execute project plans and collaborate with various departments and internal stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes and financial returns.

**What You Will Do – Primary Responsibilities**

* Support the execution of the company’s sustainability strategy while ensuring alignment with the overall business goals, mission, vision and values.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of the company’s annual Sustainability Report in alignment with sustainability standards, industry best practices and stakeholder expectations.
* Prepare presentations and management reports.
* Conduct research on relevant industry trends, best practices, standards and emerging regulations to fulfill the company’s sustainability objectives and reporting requirements.
* Facilitate the implementation of the renewable energy strategy to achieve the company's goals and targets.
* Deliver cross\-functional sustainability assignments to support the company’s sustainability strategy.
* Analyze benchmarks and key performance indicators to measure the progress, effectiveness and impact of various initiatives.
* Report on project workstream outcomes while making recommendations for improvements.
* Support analysis for annual shareholder engagement meetings on sustainability with the company’s largest investors.
* Draft responses to credit and sustainability rating agencies and the company’s key customers to optimize ratings and achieve market recognition.
* Collaborate with internal teams, including operations, accounting, and commercial affairs.
* Research relevant legislation, regulations and standards related to sustainability to ensure compliance across all markets of operations.
* Support climate risk and impact assessments, contribute to reporting under voluntary and regulatory frameworks and research strategies for risk mitigation.
* Conduct the collection, analysis and reporting of quantitative and qualitative sustainability data and metrics.
* Follow robust processes for collecting, analyzing, and verifying sustainability\-related data.
* Contribute to emissions accounting for Scopes 1, 2 and 3, in line with GHG Protocol standards and third\-party assurance requirements.
* Prepare periodic reports that track progress toward project workstreams.
* Identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, cost savings and improved resource management.
* Review external statements and policies annually.
* Foster a collaborative and innovative work environment. Provide guidance and review the work of junior team members.
* Encourage team member engagement around sustainable practices throughout the company.
* Other projects and duties as assigned.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Sustainability, or a related field.
* Master’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., MBA, Sustainability, or equivalent) preferred.
* 1 to 3 years of relevant business experience in corporate sustainability or management consulting.
* Ability to conduct research and data collection related to sustainability strategies and programs.
* Foundational business acumen.
* Experience supporting sustainability reporting activities for publicly listed companies.
* Exposure to industry standards (e.g., GRI, SASB, IFRS S1/S2, etc.) and regulatory requirements.
* Foundational analytical skills.
* Basic knowledge of emissions accounting under the GHG Protocol standards.
* Strong communication and business writing skills.

jobs.title: Regulatory Operations Analyst III
jobs.description:
You could be the one who changes everything for our 28 million members. Centene is transforming the health of our communities, one person at a time. As a diversified, national organization, you’ll have access to competitive benefits including a fresh perspective on workplace flexibility.  



*Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment\-based visa types H\-1B, L\-1, O\-1, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, or CPT.*

**Position Purpose:** Reviews, interprets and summarizes proposed and enacted legislation and regulatory updates to the business as a subject matter expert on various complex topics. Performs state or federal policy research, regulatory reporting, and regulatory change monitoring with a goal of supporting compliance, regulatory readiness, and formal regulatory approval of commercial and Marketplace products.

* Identifies, analyzes and interprets proposed or enacted legislation related to Centene's commercial product at the federal and state level and communicates findings to impacted departments.
* Independently performs risk assessments, including impact to business applications, claims operations, payment integrity processes, and downstream output.
* Maintains databases, reports, exhibits, and other reference materials related to legislative, regulatory, compliance, audit, and inquiry activities.
* Performs comprehensive, complex regulatory analyzes, including the review, summarization and dissemination of key regulatory updates and changes related to Commercial/ACA rules and regulations at the state and/or federal level.
* Leads regulatory interpretation related to Commercial/ACA Rules and regulations and the commercial product explaining concepts clearly and adapting language and presentation based on audience level.
* Provides guidance to business partners regarding emerging regulations, regulatory inquiries, audit activity, fraud, waste and abuse (FWA) oversight, and payment integrity matters.
* Coordinates regulatory inquiries, reporting requirements, exhibits, audits, and requests from state and federal agencies, maintaining accurate and timely responses in partnership with operational stakeholders.
* Partners with Compliance, Special Investigations Unit (SIU), Payment Integrity, Claims Operations, Finance, and other cross\-functional teams to identify regulatory risks, support investigations, and analyze operational trends.
* Uses persuasive arguments and secures cooperation from the business in order to address potential legal, contractual and/or regulatory issues.
* Ability to determine appropriate approach for solving regulatory problems.
* Develops trust\-based relationships within varied audiences and collaborates with other functional areas to lead large projects and initiatives.
* Attends cross\-departmental meetings as department representative, provides guidance to the business related to commercial regulatory requirements and appropriately escalates matters to management.
* Develops solutions to address potential legal, contractual and regulatory issues while working closely with Legal, Compliance, Payment Integrity, and other operational stakeholders.
* Independently drafts responses to external requests for information required by the organization for its regulatory filings and/or for policy needs.
* Responsibility for understanding regulations and business needs for multiple states, as well as federal regulations pertaining to the commercial health insurance market.
* Assesses and analyzes objections related to regulatory interpretation and leads drafting of appropriate responses which are provided to regulators related to commercial/ACA filings.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Communications, Healthcare, Political Science/Pre\-Law or equivalent experience required. Master's Degree in a related field, Juris Doctorate degree may be considered in place of experience preferred.
* 4\+ years experience in health insurance, legal, compliance or related field required.
* Experience reviewing regulations and providing interpretation using terms appropriate for the audience preferred.
* Experience in commercial health insurance, Medicaid managed care, claims operations, compliance, payment integrity, or related healthcare operations preferred.
* Experience partnering with Special Investigations Unit (SIU), Compliance, Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA), Payment Integrity, or related operational teams strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting claims operations, including medical claims processing, provider billing practices, payment accuracy, reimbursement workflows, or claims\-related regulatory activities strongly preferred.
* Experience analyzing claims data, billing trends, overpayment activity, provider utilization patterns, or operational risk indicators strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting regulatory audits, investigations, agency inquiries, corrective action plans, or regulator\-facing responses strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with Excel and experience using reporting, analytics, or business intelligence tools such as Power BI, SQL, SAS, or similar platforms strongly preferred.
* Experience within Medicaid managed care, including exposure to Medicaid Fraud Division (MFD), Medicaid Fraud Control Unit (MFCU), payment integrity, third\-party liability (TPL), or recovery activities strongly preferred.

***By applying to this requisition, you acknowledge and understand that you may be considered for other job opportunities for which Centene believes you may be qualified.***


Pay Range: $70,100\.00 \- $126,200\.00 per year
Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work

jobs.title: FMV Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Description:
**Bison Group – Mission First. People Always.**


At Bison Group LLC, we’re more than a defense contractor — we’re a people\-focused small business with a strong culture built on trust, respect, and impact. We value every member of the team, foster open communication without the layers of a big corporation, and stand firmly behind our commitment to the veteran community through real, tangible action.


When you join Bison Group, you’re not just filling a role — you’re stepping into a mission\-critical environment where your work directly supports the national security objectives. Here, your skills are recognized, your growth is encouraged, and your contributions have a clear purpose.

* Learn FMV tradecraft through a unique three\-week formal training course, followed by a robust on\-the\-job training program which provides candidates who may be new to motion GEOINT specialized instruction in FMV tradecraft, exploitation tools, and specific cultural familiarization
* Produce imagery\-derived graphic products and reports and publish for distribution
* Compile intelligence materials for use in briefings to high\-level government personnel
* Input data accurately, exploit FMV collected by sensors on ISR platforms, apply all\-source information to FMV imagery analysis, and use an electronic light table to exploit NTM imagery
* Have rapid advancement potential and cross training opportunities into Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR)/ Ground Moving Target Indicator (GMTI), and FMV Advanced Research positions.


Requirements:
* 3 years of intelligence analysis experience
* OR a bachelor’s degree in a related field
* Formal Intelligence school course (typically 2\+ months in duration, full time, resulting in an Intelligence MOS from the military (e.g. All\-Source, IMINT, SIGINT, HUMINT, etc.))
* Must be capable of working a rotating shift schedule, to include nights, weekends, and holidays
* During high\-tempo operations, maintain situational awareness and relay intelligence in real time
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and solve routine tasks
* Working knowledge of MS Office, including MS Word, MS Excel, and Power Point
* Excellent analytical, writing, and critical thinking skills
* **Type 32 words per minute without looking at the keyboard at 90% accuracy**
* Understand the basic intelligence cycle/process
* Candidates must accurately discern red, green, blue, and yellow colors on a video screen
* Must successfully complete the customer FMV training course or have do so in the last year
* Must attain FMV analyst qualifications and maintain required minimum skill level in each

**Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills**

* Basic understanding of National level imagery product standards
* Experience exploiting Full Motion Video with a basic understanding of sensor capabilities
* Familiarity with FMV operations and the TCPED process
* Experience exploiting national imagery with a basic understanding of imagery analysis
* During high\-tempo operations, can relay and articulate information
* Background in counterterrorism analysis
* Able to prepare and present briefings with creation/use of visual displays
* Can solve routine tasks of varying scope and complexity following Standard procedures

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, age, genetic information, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin\-out, and our unique combination of learning\-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion\-dollar industry.



Gravis builds the RACK, our manufacturer\-agnostic hardware and software system that turns excavators and loaders into autonomous machines, alongside Slate, our platform for planning, perception, and machine intelligence.



### **About the role**



You will own end\-to\-end program delivery for one or more key initiatives at Gravis. Technical Program Managers sit at the intersection of strategic, commercial and customer requirements, and engineering execution on squads that draw from our functional teams.



We are looking for candidates with a background in technical program management, product management, or engineering management with solid experience structuring and delivering complex cross\-team programs from planning through commercial delivery.


### **What you will do**


**Program ownership**


* Own end\-to\-end program planning and reporting for major initiatives spanning software releases, hardware integration, and field validation, tracking milestones, dependencies, and risks across distributed teams.
* Translate high\-level strategic, commercial and product goals into structured plans, roadmaps, and quarterly commitments in partnership with engineering leads.
* Identify and resolve blockers before they hit the critical path.
* Coordinate software release processes, including integration testing, regression validation, and staged rollouts to field deployments.

**Collaboration \& reporting**


* Act as the operational interface with external partners: OEM integrators, construction contractors, and equipment rental providers, coordinating requirements and delivery schedules.
* Lead cross\-team alignment and program reviews, producing clear documentation (roadmaps, RACI matrices, status dashboards) for engineering, operations, and leadership.
* Gather structured feedback from field deployments and translate it into actionable input for engineering teams.
### **What we're looking for**



We recognise that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most but not all of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.


**Core qualifications**


* 5–10 years of experience in technical program management, product management or engineering program management, or a closely related role, with a track record of delivering complex, multi\-team programs from planning through commercial delivery in a fast\-paced, deep\-tech environment.
* Solid technical foundation as evidenced by technical degree(s) in engineering or related fields.
* Hands\-on experience with agile / iterative development methodologies and tools such as Jira or Linear.
* Good working knowledge of software and hardware development practices, system architecture, and CI/CD or testing practices.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, aggressive timelines, and cross\-functional collaboration across engineering, field, and commercial stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel as required by business projects.
* High proficiency in English with the ability to read, write and present technical materials clearly and concisely.

**Nice to have**


* Experience with robotics or hardware product development cycles and embedded systems.
* Exposure to safety\-critical or field\-deployed systems.
* Experience coordinating programs across multiple countries or regulatory environments.
* Prior experience at an early\-stage hardware/software startup.
### **This role is a great fit if…**


* You care about building things that directly impact the real world at scale and work reliably outside the lab, with imperfect data, real constraints, and genuine stakes.
* You want to help build the program management function at Gravis from the ground up, establishing practices that scale as the company grows.
* You thrive when bridging disciplines, moving fluidly between hardware, software, and field operations conversations in the same day.
* You value a collaborative culture built on thoughtful design, creative problem\-solving, mutual respect, and pragmatism.
This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.



Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. The Global Customer Fulfillment (GCF) Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is seeking a Process Improvement Specialist to drive network\-wide projects and innovate new processes at scale. Your role goes beyond maintaining the current state; you are expected to think big, define a 1–3 year vision, and drive continuous improvement through scalable solutions. Your success is measured by how effectively you establish standard work, enable adoption, and make process adherence automatic rather than audit\-dependent.  

  

The Process Improvement Specialist role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data\-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Fulfillment Center (FC) Operators and Associates. Standard Work

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst

Category Support Office Roles Job Id R\-251155 Job Type Full time
  
VCA is looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst who can turn complex operational and clinical data into clearer decisions across our network of veterinary hospitals. This person will build and maintain PowerBI/Power Apps reporting, work confidently with SQL and data models, investigate the reasons behind performance trends, and partner with Business Operations and hospital leaders to improve scheduling, capacity, workflow, productivity and financial performance. We are looking for someone who is technically strong, naturally curious and able to translate analysis into practical action for non\-technical leaders.


The Business Intelligence Analyst will play a key role in transforming raw operational and clinical data into clear, actionable insights that drive efficiency, growth, and improved patient (pet) care across our hospital network. This role will own the design, build, and maintenance of Power BI dashboards and reporting tools that give hospital leaders and executives real\-time visibility into key performance indicators such as pet visit volume, appointment scheduling efficiency, staff productivity, revenue per visit, and workflow bottlenecks. The ideal candidate is equal parts analytical problem\-solver and storyteller — someone who can dig into messy data, find the "why," and communicate it clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.

***This role requires associates to work a hybrid schedule out of one of the MVH North America Hub Locations \- Vancouver, WA \| Santa Monica, CA.***

**Essential Responsibility/Tasks:**

* Design, build, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports that track hospital and network\-wide performance metrics (visit volume, appointment utilization, wait times, staff productivity, revenue, client retention, etc.)
* Partner with the VP of Business Operations and hospital leadership to identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend data\-driven process improvements
* Analyze trends in pet visit patterns, scheduling, and clinic throughput to identify opportunities to improve capacity utilization and reduce bottlenecks
* Develop and maintain data models, ETL processes, and data pipelines connecting practice management systems to Power BI and other reporting tools
* Establish and monitor KPIs across operations, clinical workflow, staffing, and financial performance
* Conduct ad hoc and deep\-dive analyses to answer strategic business questions from leadership
* Translate complex data findings into clear narratives and recommendations for non\-technical audiences, including executive presentations
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and governance across reporting tools and data sources in partnership with MVH
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Operations, Finance, HR, and Clinical teams to align on reporting needs and definitions
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and streamline manual data processes
* Support annual/quarterly business reviews with hospital\-level and network\-level performance insights

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE**:

* Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 2–5 years of experience in a business intelligence, data analyst, or operations analyst role
* Strong hands\-on proficiency with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, dashboard design)
* Solid SQL skills for querying and manipulating relational databases
* Experience working with large, multi\-location operational datasets
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present data insights to non\-technical stakeholders and senior leadership
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced, growing organization
* *All degrees will be deemed “or equivalent combination of education and experience” unless absolutely required to do the job (i.e., DVM degree for Veterinarian, Law degree for Attorney, etc.).*

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in veterinary, healthcare, dental, or multi\-site medical services industries
* Experience with Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables) and other BI tools (Tableau, Looker)
* Exposure to Python or R for data analysis/automation
* Experience with workflow/process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) a plus
* Experience working within a multi\-site or franchise/rollup corporate structure

**Additional Information:** Compensation is negotiable based on education, experience, and other relevant credentials. Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco\-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy \- Louis Vuitton, the world's largest luxury group. Kendo Total Rewards offerings also include an annual bonus and a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental and vision insurance, flex paid time off program, parental leave, employee discount/perks, a retirement plan with employer contributions, Summer Fridays, opportunity to work from anywhere for two weeks during the calendar year and December wellness/shutdown week for applicable positions.





The Kendo house of brands currently includes: Fenty Beauty, Fenty Skin, Fenty Eau de Parfum, Fenty Hair, Ole Henriksen, Lip Lab.


**SUMMARY**



As the Project Manager for a new product launch you will be responsible for planning and tracking progress through the entire lifecycle of a product, from concept to delivery. Through close partnerships with the Product Development, Packaging, Procurement, Sourcing, Regulatory and Creative partners you will ensure new products are successfully launched on time.





**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Responsible for establishing a timeline for delivering new products across multiple channels and brands.
* Create and manage detailed project plans complete with dependencies/predecessors, owners, deadlines, and duration.
* Drive issues to resolution through partnerships and creative problem solving; use rigorous logic and method to solve difficult problems with effective solution.
* Perform risk assessment in order to ensure project remains on\-time and in budget.
* Perform project post\-mortems for core launches.
* Build partnerships both internally and externally to establish a plan for delivering new products.
* Responsible for understanding and evaluating the end\-to\-end process and making recommendations on how it can be improved.
* Responsible for keeping key partners up\-to\-date on the progress of projects, risks and issues in a timely manner, and driving the team to completion of all deliverables.


**REQUIREMENTS**


* 5\+ years project management experience, in consumer packaged goods (CPG)
* Proficient with Project Management Software (Smartsheet, MS Project, Asana, Etc.) including Gantt charts
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders including cross\-functional partners and third\-party vendors
* Experience in Cosmetics, Personal Care, Health \& Beauty is preferred
* Proven track record of taking ownership, creative problem solving, and driving results
* Ability to work in fast\-paced, often\-changing environment
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to think both strategically and tactically with good attention to detail

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

  


  

**Job Description** **What you get to do in this role:**


ServiceNow's APEX (AI, Product, Engineering, and Experience) org is the largest organization in the company, comprised of all Products and Platform teams, along with our world class Design teams. We are leveraging the unlimited potential of our platform across every industry, geography, solutions, and personas to consistently deliver product and platform experiences our customers love. APEX is where ServiceNow's most critical innovations are conceived, built, and scaled — and where the programs you lead directly shape the trajectory of the company.


We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to join our APEX Strategic Programs organization. In this role, you will drive ServiceNow's most critical cross\-functional priorities and strategic programs— operating at the intersection of strategy and execution and setting the standard for how high\-impact programs are designed, governed, and run at scale.


This person will operate as an AI\-native leader, using AI tools to accelerate program delivery, synthesize intelligence across workstreams and model the ways of working we expect to scale across APEX. In addition, the candidate is a result\-oriented self\-starter with extensive competence and experience in the Technical Program Management space. This candidate thinks strategically but loves getting into the details and possesses a strong ability to conceptualize, develop, drive, coordinate and manage large, complex, cross\-functional programs supporting formal company Objectives and Key Results (OKRs). This person is effective at building relationships, collaborating, and influencing others; they must also be highly experienced working with senior executives across various geographies and functions.

**Strategic Program Management Responsibilities:**

* Drives large\-scale, high\-visibility cross\-functional programs for the APEX Strategic Programs function: Identify, prioritize, and accelerate programs of the highest complexity with quantifiable impact on revenue, market position, and competitive advantage
* Translate business objectives into execution strategy, both tactical and strategic, and take full ownership of project planning and delivery for cross\-organizational programs from initial conception through transition to operations
* Organize complex, ambiguous problems into prioritized milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and success criteria — designing programs to deliver specific strategic outcomes and drive relentless accountability against them
* Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders, technology, and functional leaders to drive focus on the strategic program objectives and optimize program delivery. This includes establishing regular cadences and holding resources accountable for their responsibilities within the program
* Develop and implement scalable processes, templates, and training to ensure program delivery and process adoption; oversee change management efforts, guiding teams through organizational transitions and improvements
* Operate as an AI\-native program manager — using AI to synthesize intelligence across workstreams, surface risk signals, ensure data informs decision\-making, draft and tailor communications at speed, direct AI agents, and provide leadership with actionable, forward\-looking intelligence
* Establish governance frameworks and lead executive\-level meetings and cross\-functional events; serve as the go\-to source of leadership, transparency, and visibility — clearly communicating objectives, status, risks, and results while ensuring surgical execution and handoffs across workstreams
* Champion AI\-native ways of working across the APEX Strategic Programs team — evaluating, adopting, and scaling AI tools that increase team throughput, reduce coordination overhead, and surface insights faster across complex program portfolios

  

  

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful is this role, you will have**

* 12\+ years of experience driving large\-scale, complex global change initiatives and programs to successful implementation: preferably in Technical Program Management, Strategic Program Management, Mergers and Acquisition Integrations, Management Consulting, or Strategy roles
* High energy, disciplined execution skills; willingness to do whatever it takes to deliver results
* Work independently and be highly productive with minimal oversight
* Ability to see the big picture while being execution\-oriented to improve operational excellence
* Effective communicator — written and verbal — who uses AI tools to draft, refine, and tailor communications; able to convey complex ideas clearly across executive and working\-level audiences at speed, and comfortable directing AI agents and iterating on outputs in ambiguous, high\-stakes environments
* Strong collaboration, relationship\-building, and influence skills — exceptionally skilled at bringing people together across functions, levels, and geographies without direct authority
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving — including AI\-powered tools, workflow automation, AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on program management an

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Survey Department
jobs.description:
Adobe Associates, Inc. is a prominent civil engineering and land surveying firm located in the heart of Sonoma County. Our company has been surveying in the North Bay region for over 44 years, and we are looking for an experienced land surveyor to join our team. Help us provide quality surveying services for our clients! The ideal candidate will have land surveying experience (5\+ years \& management experience strongly preferred), and be proficient in all aspects of land surveying, including boundary surveys, topographic surveys, construction staking, ALTA/ACSM surveys, legal descriptions, and more. The candidate will also be responsible for preparing and submitting survey reports and working with clients to meet their needs. If you believe you meet the criteria below, please contact Aaron Smith, PLS, by email at asmith@adobeinc.com


**What makes a Qualified Candidate:**


* Licensed in the State of California as a Professional Land Surveyor (or at minimum currently seeking licensure)
* Familiarity with working in Sonoma, Marin, and Napa County and good working relationships with the agencies within those jurisdictions.
* 5\+ years management experience – especially of multiple crews
* Experience in field work, field procedures, \& current application of equipment used today
* Experience with Topographic Mapping, Records of Survey, ALTA’s, Subdivision Maps and processes, Lot Line Adjustments, Construction Staking and Calculations, Legal Descriptions for LLA’s, easements, PG\&E, Leases, and more.
* Experience with AutoCAD/Civil 3D
* Experience with Drone and a UAG 107 license.
* Strong background in construction layout and the ability to coordinate with multiple disciplines, whether internal to Adobe or external.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills – to coordinate with clients and consultants and work internally with other departments such as wastewater, civil engineering, and permitting

  


**Responsibilities include:**


* Preparing Records of Survey, LLA’s, Certificates of Compliance, Subdivisions, and others.
* Preparing proposals \& Service Agreements for potential clients
* Occasionally performing field work – surveys, staking, site visits, managing
* Managing the field crew schedule and adjusting to the needs of the company and client as needed.
* Work with agencies on project\-related matters
* Prepare and submit survey reports
* Work with clients to ensure that their needs are met
* Stay up\-to\-date on the latest land surveying regulations and standards
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records

  


**Compensation and Benefits:**


* Competitive salary and benefits package:
* LSIT with 4\-6 years of management experience: $90,000 – $115,000
* PLS: $125,000 – $155,000 plus quarterly bonuses (PLS must have experience managing complex projects with demonstrated ability to work with a variety of stakeholders on a project team; 5\+ years’ experience preferred.)
* Comprehensive medical plan options
* 401(k) savings plan
* 9/80 or 4/10 schedule option available based on ability to meet project goals
* Generous paid holidays and personal time off
* Professional license reimbursement benefits
* Wellness Program
* Office events and parties
* Opportunity to work with a team of experienced professionals
* Challenging and rewarding work environment
* Limited remote work opportunity


**About the Company:**



Adobe Associates Inc. is a well\-established full\-service civil engineering and land surveying firm located in Santa Rosa, California – in the heart of the world\-renowned Sonoma Valley wine country. We have been in business since 1982, specializing in wineries, hospitality and resorts, residential and commercial development, estates, subdivisions, vineyard planning and planting, and municipal projects.



Adobe is a multi\-time winner of the North Bay Business Journal “Best Places to Work” award. Our core values of client focus, integrity, respect, quality, teamwork, and family have defined our culture and continue to attract exceptional people to our firm. We value the contribution of every employee – mutual respect and professionalism are shared among all staff.

  


**How to Apply:**



If you would like to be considered for the position, please send your cover letter and resume to asmith@adobeinc.com.  

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager – Financial Operations
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

  

We are seeking a highly motivated, strategic, and detail\-oriented **Senior Business Operations Manager (Financial Operations)** to oversee organizational budget strategy, financial operations, and process optimization. This role is responsible for end\-to\-end budget management, financial modeling, procurement control, and automated reporting. Operating as a bridge between Finance, Operations, and departmental leads, you will leverage advanced modeling tools and procurement systems to provide actionable financial insights, drive operational efficiency, and safeguard data integrity.

 **Responsibilities**

**Strategic Budget Management \& Financial Operations**

* Oversee, prepare, and analyze comprehensive organizational budgets, financial statements, and multi\-year forecasts (monthly, quarterly, annual).
* Implement and enforce budget control measures to ensure compliance with corporate guidelines and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor budget vs. actual performance across departments, conducting variance analysis to identify risks, trends, and reallocations for senior leadership.
* Manage procurement workflows, budget tracking, and vendor spend utilizing **Coupa** software.

**Financial Modeling \& Process Automation**

* Build, maintain, and enhance complex financial models and interactive dashboards using advanced data tools (Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, Pivot Tables, Macros, VBA).
* Drive process improvement initiatives to streamline budgeting workflows, automating manual reporting tasks to increase accuracy and speed.
* Standardize data validation, quality control measures, and clear documentation for all financial processes.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Strategic Advice**

* Collaborate closely with department heads and senior executives to gather inputs, align financial targets with strategic business goals, and present executive\-level summaries.
* Deliver clear, data\-driven recommendations regarding financial adjustments, headcount planning, and operational investments.
* Act as a subject matter expert, providing financial guidance and training to non\-financial business partners.

 **Qualifications**

 **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. (Master’s/MBA or CPA a plus).

**Experience:** 8–10\+ years of progressive experience in business operations, financial analysis, budgeting, or financial operations.**Technical Skills:*** **Advanced Excel \& Data Modeling:** Expert proficiency in dynamic formulas, pivot tables, charts, data validation, macros, and VBA.
* **Cloud Collaboration:** Hands\-on proficiency with Google Sheets for real\-time tracking and reporting.
* **Procurement \& Financial Systems:** Direct experience using **Coupa** for procurement and budget oversight; experience with enterprise ERP systems is highly desirable.

**Core Competencies:*** Exceptional financial acumen, analytical thinking, and quantitative problem\-solving.
* Meticulous attention to detail and data integrity.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to translate complex financial metrics into concise operational strategies.
* Proven track record of managing competing priorities and leading cross\-functional alignment in high\-growth environments.

  

Footer
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

Mountain View $134,500 \- $182,000

jobs.description:
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Atlanta, GA, USA; Addison, TX, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Geology, Biology, Meteorology, related fields, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* 5 years of experience implementing environmental programs in the tech sector.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Geology, Biology, Meteorology, or related fields.
* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience or knowledge of mission critical operations with respect to high\-stakes environmental programs and communications management.
* Experience or knowledge of acoustical engineering and acoustical data analysis.
* Outstanding skills and experience in collaboration and relationship\-building with cross\-functional teams and executive\-level stakeholders, and strong problem\-solving and project management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


Google Data Centers (GDC) make up one of the largest and most powerful computing infrastructures on the planet. The Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) program enables compliance and safety excellence in design, construction, commissioning, deployment and operations of Google owned and third\-party data centers at scale.


As a member of the GDC Compliance, Security and Risk Management (CSRM) Environmental team, you will be responsible for developing, implementing and maintaining the environmental programs across the Google Cloud teams not only in compliance with the regulatory requirements but also by pushing the program boundaries to establish and forward looking community concerns related environmental programs. You will play a critical part in working collaboratively with cross\-functional teams across Google Cloud to identify programmatic gaps, develop and execute timely and scalable end\-to\-end environmental programs to protect Google’s interests and have a lasting impact in the data center communities. You will also provide program leadership and oversight to new and critical environmental initiatives to continue to create and iterate our Google EHS program.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and steer the global vision and strategy for GDC’s Environmental Programs, prioritizing community concerns related environmental program, aligning regional initiatives with evolving Google standards and global GDC operational models.
* Partner with executive GDC leadership, CSRM, and EHS stakeholders to integrate and execute environmental initiatives as a core GDC business strategy to enable licenses to operate.
* Standardize and oversee the global environmental risk management framework to identify, evaluate, and mitigate end\-to\-end environmental risks, while ensuring proactive adaptation to market forces.
* Establish and monitor global Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), driving global and industry level benchmarking across all operating models with a focus on community\-specific environmental impacts.

* 8 years of experience leading cross\-functional planning initiatives involving engineering, product, operations, or finance organizations.
* 8 years of experience performing quantitative analysis and presenting recommendations to executive leadership.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in hyperscale infrastructure planning, capacity planning, investment planning, or infrastructure strategy.

* Excellent problem solving, executive communication, and stakeholder management skills.

-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Capacity Planning Lead, you will lead strategic infrastructure planning initiatives that evaluate future capacity requirements, analyze infrastructure trade\-offs, and develop executive recommendations that influence Alphabet's infrastructure investment strategy. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $188000 \- $274000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead strategic capacity planning initiatives supporting Alphabet's infrastructure investments across compute, storage, networking, power, and data center infrastructure. Evaluate infrastructure alternatives by analyzing demand growth, engineering constraints, supply availability, deployment options, investment trade\-offs, and business risks.
* Develop planning frameworks that improve the speed, consistency, and quality of infrastructure planning decisions. Build executive\-ready business cases, investment analyses, and recommendations supporting infrastructure prioritization and allocation decisions.
* Partner across product areas, engineering, supply chain, finance, and data science to integrate evolving planning signals into a unified infrastructure plan of record.
* Define planning assumptions, evaluation methodologies, business rules, and decision frameworks that improve planning quality across Alphabet.
* Partner with Engineering teams to define business requirements for capacity planning systems, optimization capabilities, and decision\-support tooling. Integrate planning recommendations into Alphabet's long\-range infrastructure planning and executive investment processes.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, New Revenue Initiatives
jobs.description:
Finance and Business Planning is a highly mission\-driven organization. Our mission is to enable Meta to plan, prioritize, and execute as effectively as possible. We take a uniquely long\-term view towards business problems. It is critical that we operate with an independent and objective perspective and can represent our point of view to our partners and executive stakeholders. We serve as financial advisers to our business partners and own shared business goals and results where appropriate. We strive to balance our responsibility to support business partners with our responsibility to serve the long\-term mission and sustainability of Meta and act as stewards of the company's resources. This role requires strategic thinking, building connections and influencing stakeholders through effective communication, an analytical mindset, and a bias towards action. You will be challenged to understand and contribute to rapidly changing business models, drive collaboration across teams, develop recommendations on strategic investment decisions, craft annual and long\-term plans, and partner with leaders to solve problems and achieve goals. Our promise: you will gain invaluable experience in a position that offers significant responsibility, interaction with product and business leaders, and an opportunity to have a big impact.  

  

  

### **Business Operations Manager, New Revenue Initiatives Responsibilities:**

* Provide financial leadership across company\-wide planning cycles: long\-range plan (LRP), annual budget, and half\-year roadmapping
* Develop nuanced ROI and impact frameworks across headcount, expenses, and other investments that will influence key decision\-makers to allocate resources more efficiently
* Create/socialize data\-driven narratives and influence outcomes and decisions at the executive level
* Establish strategic partnerships with leaders of all levels and functions across business functions
* Help define and implement scalable financial processes to make us and our business partners more efficient
* Develop a solid quantitative and qualitative understanding of Meta's GTM, product, and business model with partners

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 9\+ years of experience in business strategy, finance, analytics, or consulting and planning
* BA/BS in a quantitative field (data science, computer science, economics, finance, etc.) or an equivalent degree/experience
* Experience in data analytics, data visualization, and scenario\-based analysis
* Experience leading cross\-functional projects with executive stakeholders

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting Enterprise or SaaS based Go\-To\-Market motions and or new revenue lines with an emphasis on AI monetization (e.g. Subscriptions, Enterprise Contracts)
* Experience working in a complex, fast\-paced environment or in a high\-growth company
* Experience working directly with executives
* High level of ownership and experience in driving cross\-functional initiatives with minimal guidance
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  

  

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com.  

  

$162,000/year to $229,000/year \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.title: Security Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Site Manager  


We help make your world a safer place.  


Securitas is a global company that offers the most advanced and sustainable security solutions in the industry. We are located in 47 countries and have 355,000 employees worldwide and over 150,000 clients.  


Securitas plays an essential role for our clients and in society. The Site Manager position helps maintain a safe and secure environment for our clients by providing lead direction to Security Officers at assigned client site. Observes and reports activities and incidents, providing for the security and safety of client property and personnel. Preserves order and may act to enforce regulations and directives for the site pertaining to personnel, visitors, and premises.

The Cybersecurity Awareness Analyst leads the design and execution of the organization’s security awareness and training programs in support of its healthcare and research mission. UCSF Cybersecurity protects and responds to both internal and external threats. It monitors for vulnerabilities, risks, and exposures and mitigates issues prior to exploitation. If an incident does occur, IT Security investigates, determines impact, and recommends controls for reduced recurrence likelihood.

**Position:** Full\-Time, On\-Site**Overview:**


Emerge Solutions Group is seeking an experienced **Data Analyst** to support the Resource Management Office at David Grant Medical Center (DGMC), Travis Air Force Base. This position provides advanced data analysis, business planning, performance measurement, and decision support services to support the Defense Health Agency (DHA) Business Performance Plan and DGMC operational objectives.


The Data Analyst will analyze complex healthcare, operational, financial, and performance data; develop dashboards and executive\-level reports; conduct business case and return\-on\-investment analyses; and provide actionable recommendations to support clinical and organizational decision\-making. The ideal candidate has significant experience with DHA medical systems or equivalent civilian healthcare systems, advanced business intelligence and visualization capabilities, and the ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations for executive leadership.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support DGMC projects and optimization initiatives through data analysis, data mining, coordination, recommendations, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Provide timely and accurate business planning and analytical support for taskings originating from DHA, higher headquarters, Defense Health Network (DHN) Central, and DGMC leadership.
* Design, analyze, and develop information products, technical reports, presentations, dashboards, and other data visualization products using Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence tools.
* Recommend, design, create, monitor, and maintain performance metrics, dashboards, benchmarks, and comparative measurement tools.
* Present monthly Business Plan Performance results to executive staff in concise, data\-driven briefings.
* Mine and analyze data from DoD Medical Mart (M2\), MHS GENESIS Electronic Medical Record (EMR), DHA medical databases, data warehouses, and other authorized healthcare information systems.
* Provide requested MHS GENESIS or DoD M2 data queries and snapshots within established contract performance requirements.
* Develop Business Case Analyses (BCA), Return on Investment (ROI) analyses, and other technical reports and presentations to support resource allocation and organizational decision\-making.
* Conduct audits and quality assurance activities and provide analytical findings and recommendations to DGMC leadership.
* Analyze current operations and information systems to identify opportunities for optimization, process improvement, and corrective action.
* Develop strategies for integrating new or improved technologies with existing operational and information systems.
* Conduct qualitative and quantitative impact analyses to evaluate proposed policy, program, or benefit changes.
* Evaluate market viability, including demographics, competition, benefit penetration, and other factors associated with new services or optimization of existing services.
* Provide analytical support for initiatives including federal sharing opportunities, Military Health System Support Initiatives (MHSSI), Military Construction (MILCON), manpower studies, and other healthcare optimization efforts.
* Analyze and evaluate business strategies to determine feasibility, organizational impact, and return on investment.
* Communicate complex analytical concepts, findings, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including MTF leadership and action officers.

This position allows for up to 4 days of remote work per week, and limited travel may be required. Position offered will be based off of qualifications and experience.


*\*\*\*\*Application will close on October 16, 2026, at 5 pm.\*\*\**

**About the Office**

The Office of Access \& Inclusion (OA\&I) leads the grantmaking for legal services, and policymaking on access to justice and diversity, equity, and inclusion work at the State Bar. In 2026, OA\&I, working with the Legal Services Trust Fund Commission (LSTFC) and the Board of Trustees, distributed approximately $300 million to 118 nonprofit legal aid organizations serving all 58 California counties. OA\&I also supports various initiatives to promote and advance diversity, equity, and inclusion in the legal profession by partnering with other offices of the State Bar and external stakeholders.


**About the Job**

The State Bar of California seeks a full\-time Program Analyst or Senior Program Analyst who will be a key member of the grants team. Responsibilities may include administering grants for legal services to low\-income Californians; supporting grant compliance by helping ensure grantees meet statutory and program requirements and reporting deadlines; researching and writing memos to the LSTFC and its committees; maintaining important relationships with volunteers, agencies, grantees, and other stakeholders ; and developing and managing a variety of projects to help increase transparency, efficiency, and impact of grants administration. This position will require travel to visit in\-person with State Bar grantees and other stakeholders.  



**The Ideal Candidate**

The successful candidate will be an excellent communicator with precise writing and analytical skills; demonstrate sound judgment and attention to detail; and have strong project management and organizational skills. Because of OA\&I’s work with public commissions and councils, other State Bar offices, and external stakeholders, collaboration and relationship building skills are essential. Experience in compliance, public speaking, legal aid, or grantmaking is a plus. The team values people who bring a passion for social justice, collegiality, and integrity to the workplace.  



**PROGRAM ANALYST:**

**DEFINITION**

Under general supervision, the Program Analyst performs a variety of analytical, technical, and administrative duties in assigned State Bar divisions/units.


**DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS**

The Program Analyst classification is a journey\-level professional classification distinguished from the lower level Program Coordinator in that the latter is focused on administrative coordination, whereas the Program Analyst is the professional class performing analysis and technical assistance.


**EXAMPLES OF ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

Duties may include, but are not limited to the following:


* Performs professional work in support of State Bar programs and services within the various State Bar divisions/units, as assigned, involving the knowledge, interpretation, and application of State Bar policies, rules, regulations, and procedures.
* Researches information by identifying, locating and extracting relevant data in order to obtain sufficient, valid and reliable data for analysis and decision making purposes.
* Reviews processes and maintains program transactions, records and other documents; assists in the preparation and maintenance of statistical data, reports, correspondence, special studies, and conducts research.
* Participates in a variety of complex and detailed programmatic responsibilities involving problem solving.
* Evaluates program effectiveness by comparing outcomes to goals in order to determine whether to take corrective actions or recommend modification to processes and procedures.
* Performs research into program and quality control regulations and procedures; prepares reports on findings; identifies problems of non\-compliance; recommends corrective action regarding discrepancies.
* Conducts audits to determine if there are program inconsistencies or non\-compliance.
* Provides input in developing and evaluating program policies and procedures and evaluates and proposes changes concerning the methods of operation.
May perform a number of other similar or related duties which may not be specifically included within this position description, but which are consistent with the general level of the job.  
*

Computerized information and database recordkeeping systems.

new_jobs.description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG — the platform that 200\+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.


We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.


If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

**The Role**
------------


As an Applied AI Data Analyst, you will bridge the gap between our massive, unstructured financial and operational datasets to our core R\&D team. You will own the evaluation platform of our agentic workflows forecasting pipelines, as well as improve customer facing insights leading to mission\-critical decisions.


This role is part of the Applied AI Research department, with options to advance to senior data science and AI/ML engineering roles.

**Location:** New York, NY (In\-Person \| Relocation supported)

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Algorithm \& LLM Evaluation:** Analyze edge cases, model predictions, hallucination rates, and extraction accuracy for our LLM\-driven document processing systems and agentic workflows.
* **Root Cause Analysis:** Dig deep into complex datasets (inconsistent financial documents, fragmented enterprise systems) to determine why an extraction or time\-series model succeeded or failed.
* **Golden Dataset Curation:** Define, curate, and maintain gold\-standard evaluation datasets ("golden sets") for automated backtesting of AI agents and demand forecasting models.
* **Performance Monitoring \& Evals:** Build dashboards, data transformations, and evaluation harnesses to monitor system health, model drift, and AI performance metrics across release cycles.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner directly with applied AI engineers, product managers and business operations managers to turn qualitative real\-world problem definitions into quantitative product defining insights.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

### **Required**

* **Education:** Graduate degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or a related STEM field.
* **Experience:** 2–4 years of experience in a quantitative data analyst or AI evaluation role, working closely alongside AI/ML R\&D teams.
* **Programming \& Agentic AI:** Proficiency in **Python** and hands\-on works with AI/ML models
* **Data Stack:** Strong capabilities with SQL and enterprise data infrastructure (**PostgreSQL**, **Snowflake**, **dbt**, **AWS**).
* **Analytical Mindset:** Exceptional ability to translate noisy, unstructured document data into rigorous evaluation insights for engineers.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with LLM observability, tracing, and eval frameworks (**LangSmith**, **Arize AI**, or **TruLens**).
* Proficiency with **agentic workflows** or multi\-agent orchestration.
* Familiarity with demand forecasting, time\-series models, or statistical modeling.
* Comfort in fast\-moving, high\-growth NYC startup environments.

**Perks \+ Benefits**
---------------------

* **Equity** — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
* **Fully paid health coverage through Aetna** — we cover 100% of employee premiums
* **Top\-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian**
* **Carrot Fertility Pro** — comprehensive fertility and family\-forming support
* **12 weeks of paid parental leave**
* **Unlimited PTO** — plus regular 4\-day holiday weekends we actually take
* **401(k) through Vestwell**
* **Paid relocation support** — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
* **Fully equipped workspace from day one** — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
* **Team perks** — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee \+ snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

*Confido provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*
